name: simple
description: Make truthful software decisions and write concise developer prose in plain Markdown.

interface.shortDescription: Simple solutions grounded in repository reality
interface.longDescription: Ground software design in repository truth and help agents write concise plans, documentation, comments, prompts, reviews, and handoffs in plain Markdown without speculative machinery or decorative prose.
defaultPrompt: Use Simple for this architecture or change-design decision

Review this design, document, or diff with Simple
